clusters.cluster_title: Document OCR & Numerical Receipt Indexing Failure
clusters.description: Users recall text-heavy media (receipts, stickers, bills, invoices) by prices, merchant names, or partial words. Search fails due to unindexed small printed/handwritten text or currency symbols.
top_verbatim_quotes: Can't find my car insurance policy receipt from Best Buy
Need to find my laptop receipt invoice text was missing

clusters.description: Users recall salient visual cues (clothing colors, background structures, or negated attributes like 'not smiling'). Search produces semantic drift (e.g. matching 'yellow jacket' to wasps or 'red barn' to red cars).
top_verbatim_quotes: Looking for a yellow jacket photo on a hiking trail
Searching for a photo of my friend wearing yellow shirt
